label: A total-holding series cannot go on to infinity
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred: the total-holding per se relation AsTotallyHeld (definition 5462ce35-4970-434c-8f2a-0ccc2c1db805) is well founded, so there is no infinite ascending chain of total holders each totally held in the act by which it holds. The restriction of the holding regress 6f924bb0-beb4-4a7c-845e-ceb9b7aeb3c1 to the total-holding series; a well-founded holding per se relation restricts to a well-founded total one only if the total links are among the holding links, which is not assumed here.
